notes: Technical description of src/WhaleTaxHook.sol and src/WhaleToken.sol; ABI exports are docs/abi/WhaleTaxHook.json and docs/abi/WhaleToken.json. The hook takes only the approved Sepolia PoolManager address; the token constructor takes no arguments. Hook permissions are exactly beforeSwap, afterSwap and afterSwapReturnDelta, with address bits 0x00C4 validated in the constructor; deployment requires a matching CREATE2 address. The intended pool has currency0 native ETH and currency1 WHAL. The initialPrice adopts the existing launch rehearsal's tick 154200: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(154200), encoded as decimal sqrtPriceX96, approximately 4,971,484.53 WHAL per ETH. This price supports the rehearsed one-sided WHAL liquidity range below the initial tick and a first buy into an ETH-less pool. The pool's static LP fee is 3000 (0.30%), separate from the hook tax. beforeSwap records the pre-swap sqrt price in transient storage keyed by PoolId; afterSwap clears it and computes the price move m in bps from the squared price ratio using FullMath. The tax rate is 30 + floor(470 * min(m, 500) / 500) bps, capped at 500 bps. A positive afterSwap delta charges the unspecified leg: output for exact-in, additional input for exact-out. Fees round down and settle as ERC-6909 claims minted to the hook. Permissionless burnFees(currency) transfers accrued claims to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD inside unlockCallback; it does not withdraw underlying currency or reduce token supply. Active callbacks accept only the PoolManager. There are no initialize or liquidity permissions. Pools with non-native currency0 receive zero swap deltas and no accounting changes; other native-ETH pools attached to this hook are taxed too. Fee balances are aggregated per currency. The tax is per swap, so splitting a trade can lower it; hookData is ignored. This manifest describes constructor and pool inputs, not launch policy or authorization. Source publication, signed artifact linkage, admission and deployment are later service responsibilities; no service outcome is asserted here.
